rule: A catalogue medicine is controlled when any of its ingredients is a listed substance (or one of its salts, named under matches), with that substance's class; otherwise not controlled. The Act covers anything that contains a listed substance (s. 2) and the salts of listed substances (Schedules 2 and 3).
